name: ecdsa
entry_points_source: README.md, section Usage (lines 295-297), and docs/source/quickstart.rst, section Verifying (lines 157-178), show VerifyingKey.verify; docs/source/ecdsa.keys.rst (automodule of ecdsa.keys) documents VerifyingKey.verify, 'Verify a signature made over provided data' (src/ecdsa/keys.py line 638), and VerifyingKey.verify_digest, 'Verify a signature made over provided hash value' (line 695); docs/source/ecdsa.eddsa.rst (automodule of ecdsa.eddsa) documents PublicKey.verify, 'Verify a Pure EdDSA signature over data' (src/ecdsa/eddsa.py line 132), which VerifyingKey.verify calls for Edwards curves (keys.py lines 676-681). Entry points are names, so the same names elsewhere in the package count too. Public_key.verifies (src/ecdsa/ecdsa.py lines 184-186) returns True or False and is no entry point.
rejection_bases_source: src/ecdsa/keys.py: the docstring of VerifyingKey.verify names BadSignatureError, 'if the signature is invalid or malformed' (line 668); that of VerifyingKey.verify_digest names BadSignatureError and BadDigestError, 'if the provided digest is too big for the curve associated with this VerifyingKey and allow_truncate was not set' (lines 718-720); README.md, section Usage (lines 295-297): verify 'either returns True or raises BadSignatureError'. Each of the 2 classes inherits from the built-in Exception alone (keys.py lines 38 and 53), so each is a base. The docstring of eddsa.PublicKey.verify (src/ecdsa/eddsa.py line 132) names no exception.
suite_runs_source: tox.ini, [testenv] (line 30): 1 pytest call on src/ecdsa, under coverage; .github/workflows/ci.yml runs it for Python 3.12 as tox -e py312 (lines 83-86 and 340-342)
